data.long_meaning: Jelene is derived from the Slavic element ‘jelo’ meaning ‘dawn’ or ‘daybreak’. This name is associated with new beginnings, hope, and the promise of a bright future. In Christianity, Jelene may symbolize the rising sun of salvation.

Ultimately, this name is an embodiment of the beauty, hope, and renewal that can be found in the love of God.
